newsitem.title: BURMA: Japan grants fresh aid to Burma.
newsitem.headline: Japan grants fresh aid to Burma.

text.p: Japan, a major creditor of Burma, has granted a two billion yen ($17.2 million) loan to the Burmese military government, the Japanese embassy in Rangoon said on Monday.
The loan brings Japan's total loans to Burma to 102.9 billion yen ($884.4 million) over the past two decades, Japanese diplomatic sources said.
Japan latest aid to debt-ridden Burma comes just after the Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN) agreed to give Rangoon, as well as Cambodia and Laos, membership in July.
ASEAN at present groups Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, Vietnam and Thailand.
